draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 6th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 30 at DT. He went 16th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: John Franklin-Myers. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2024) ranked 3rd in sacks among the 30 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 6 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (12th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 interior lineman who played: 7 pressures against a median of 2, above the norm.
